notes.title: Vote on the next Items/Guffins! New Starting Bonuses!
notes.content:
Players, you can vote on the next items/guffins to be added to the game [url=https://strawpoll.com/polls/e6Z288p86nN]here! [/url]

Patch Notes:

1. Starting Bonus: 
[list]
[*]  A new starting bonus has been added for players who have defeated a boss in their previous adventure. 
[*]  Players will be able to choose a bonus when starting their next adventure. 
[*]  Note: This feature is not retroactive.
[/list]

2. Difficulty Levels: 
[list]
[*]  The difficulty levels have been opened up for all players. 
[*]  All players will now start with 4 levels of difficulty unlocked.
[/list]

3. Bug Fixes: 
[list]
[*]  Minor bugs have been fixed, including the Venom Vial.
[/list]

notes.title: First Patch! And Huge Thank you's
notes.content:
[b]Thank you all so much for playing PBA. [/b]
We are immensely proud of this project, from the mechanics, and the scope of content, to the execution and unique style. For that reason your enjoyment means the world to us. 

Thank you to all who have left your thoughtful reviews! We value your input highly and it's always considered. [i]Special shout-out to our Kickstarter backers who have are making use of their activation codes![/i]

Our [url=https://discord.gg/zZnzrpKJ]Discord Server[/url] recently held a poll to see which new items will be added in this patch! 
The following items are the winners :) 

[b]Blowgun Extended[/b] -> Cost 1 Energy. Gain 1 Hit.
This Blowgun increases Hits and Energy cost with each use.

[b]Book of Burns Extended[/b] -> Cost 6 Energy. Add 5 Hits.
Each time you lose HP this Book of Burns lowers its Energy cost by 1. 
Resets when used.

[b]Ink & Quill Extended[/b] -> Cost 2 Energy. Spells a word for you but only reveals the first 2 letters.

[b]Musket Extended[/b] -> Cost 4 Energy. For each vowel in your word, gain 2 Hits.

[b]Trapped Soul Extended[/b] -> When you draw a penalty card change its letter to a random vowel.

Each of these are added to the Hero unlock system. So as you progress with each Hero you will gain access to these new community chosen Items and Guffins! Hop in and join us on Discord if you would like to participate in these hands-on changes. 


Here are the patchnotes.

[b]Fixes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed flipping enemy with certain items causing game lock.
[*] Handsome Hunk fixed giving hex.
[*] Fixed Baroness having a duplicate icon over play hits.
[*] Fixed Dragon item sacrifice scroll not working.
[*] Fixed Cards that compare icons breaking on enemy flip.
[*] Fixed Plothook achievement being misaligned from actual unlock condition.
[/list]

[b]Cosmetic:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Kraken passive wording.
[*] Fixed Shark Abridged reward flavor text.
[*] Adjusted some audio levels.
[*] Added a few sfx.
[*] Fixed Hero name plates displaying internal names.
[*] Shrank letter select for wild cards slightly.
[/list]

[b]Item changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Update Brand New Skateboard to target last card.
[*] Reduce Battery Pack Energy cost by 1.
[*] Buffed Gambling Dice draw 1-3 -> 2-4.
[/list]


[b]Additionally:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed penalty GH from any future games.
[*] Added penalty [TH, NT, ND, NG, ED]
[*] Buffed Plothook card icons slightly.
[*] Added extended items to the last hero level.
[*] Changed Wild card:
      Left click no longer opens letter select when card is up.
      Drag to stage still opens letter select.
      Right click now opens letter select.
[*] Added Word Suggestion to menu in battles, allowing players to submit words they believe should be added to our dictionary.
[*] Added a back button to the enemy view screen after clicking the Next Battle button.
[/list]

Thanks again everyone for all your support. Happy spelling!
